fullPassage: The twenty-first-century event manager has a responsibility to their clients and stakeholders that requires the delivery of an event which minimises negative impacts and can endure without the overconsumption of resources. Sustainable events will have a positive impact on people, the planet and profit margins and thus help to meet the economic, sociocultural and environmental needs of event stakeholders. Furthermore, professional event planners have an increasing ethical and legal duty to plan and deliver events that are environmentally, socially and culturally responsible. Responsible events are sensitive to the economic, sociocultural and environmental needs within a local host community, and are organised in order to create the best output for all involved or affected by the event, and in reality, for many event professionals, sustainability is now equated with survival. This means that placing sustainability at the core of event management practices is not just important, but it has become an essential part of the role, and event organisers must adopt increasingly responsible practices in order to stay competitive.

전문 행사 기획자에게는 환경적·사회적·문화적으로 책임 있는 행사를 기획할 윤리적·법적 의무가 있다.
지속가능성은 일부 대형 행사에만 해당하는 선택적 요소이다.

questions.passage: The twenty-first-century event manager has a responsibility to their clients and stakeholders that requires the delivery of an event which minimises negative impacts and can endure without the overconsumption of resources. Sustainable events will have a positive impact on people, the planet and profit margins and thus help to meet the economic, sociocultural and environmental needs of event stakeholders. Furthermore, professional event planners have an increasing ethical and legal duty to plan and deliver events that are environmentally, socially and culturally responsible. Responsible events are sensitive to the economic, sociocultural and environmental needs within a local host community, and are organised in order to create the best output for all involved or affected by the event, and in reality, for many event professionals, sustainability is now equated with survival. This means that placing sustainability at the core of event management practices is not just important, but it has become an essential part of the role, and event organisers must adopt increasingly responsible practices in order to stay competitive.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 내용과 일치하지 않는 것은?

det.korean: event organisers must adopt increasingly responsible practices in order to stay competitive. 책임 있는 관행은 경쟁력을 '유지하기 위한' 것이지 '포기하고서라도' 하는 것이 아니므로 ④가 불일치.
det.analysis:
❌ ① 지역사회 필요에 민감 — 'sensitive to the economic, sociocultural and environmental needs' 일치예요.
❌ ② 사람·지구·이윤에 긍정적 — 'positive impact on people, the planet and profit margins' 일치예요.
❌ ③ 지속가능성을 핵심에 — 'placing sustainability at the core ... is not just important' 일치예요.
✅ ④ 경쟁력을 포기하더라도 — 본문은 오히려 'in order to stay competitive(경쟁력을 유지하기 위해)' 도입한다고 했어요. '포기'가 정반대라 불일치 ←정답
det.tip: in order to stay competitive = 경쟁력을 유지하기 위해 (포기 아님)

ch: 책임 있는 행사는 지역 개최 지역사회의 경제적·사회문화적·환경적 필요에 민감하다.
지속 가능한 행사는 사람, 지구, 그리고 이윤 모두에 긍정적인 영향을 준다.
글쓴이는 지속가능성을 행사 관리의 핵심에 두는 것을 중요하게 여긴다.
행사 주최자는 경쟁력을 포기하더라도 책임 있는 관행을 도입해야 한다.

questions.passage: The twenty-first-century event manager has a responsibility to their clients and stakeholders that requires the delivery of an event which ①<u>minimises</u> negative impacts and can endure without the overconsumption of resources. Sustainable events will have a positive impact on people, the planet and profit margins and thus help to meet the economic, sociocultural and environmental needs of event stakeholders. Furthermore, professional event ②<u>planners has</u> an increasing ethical and legal duty to plan and deliver events that are environmentally, socially and culturally responsible. Responsible events are sensitive to the economic, sociocultural and environmental needs within a local host community, and are organised in order to ③<u>create</u> the best output for all involved or affected by the event, and in reality, for many event professionals, sustainability is now equated with survival. This means that placing sustainability at the core of event management practices is not just important, but it has become an essential part of the role, and event organisers must ④<u>adopt</u> increasingly responsible practices in order to stay competitive.
questions.stem: 다음 글에서 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ② planners has → planners have: 주어 professional event planners가 복수이므로 동사도 복수형 have여야 한다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① minimises — 'an event which minimises': 선행사 an event(단수)에 맞춘 단수동사, 정상이에요.

✅ ② planners has — 원문은 planners have. 주어 'professional event planners(전문 행사 기획자들)'는 복수라서 동사도 복수형 have여야 해요. has는 단수동사라 틀려요 ←정답

❌ ③ create — 'in order to create': 'to + 동사원형', 정상이에요.

❌ ④ adopt — 'must adopt': 조동사 must 뒤 동사원형, 정상이에요.
det.tip: 복수 주어(planners) + 복수동사 have (has ✕)

_____ (place) sustainability at the core is now essential. (영어로, 1단어)

det.korean: 문장의 주어 자리이므로 동사 place를 동명사 placing으로 바꿔 '~하는 것'이라는 의미의 주어로 만든다. 본문 'placing sustainability at the core ... is'.
det.analysis: 빈칸은 문장의 주어 자리예요. 동사 place를 그대로 쓸 수 없고, '~하는 것'이라는 주어를 만들려면 동명사 placing으로 바꿔요. 'Placing sustainability at the core(지속가능성을 핵심에 두는 것)'가 주어가 되고 동사는 is예요.
det.tip: 주어 자리의 동명사: place → placing (~하는 것)

questions.stem: 다음 글의 주제로 가장 적절한 것은?

questions.stem:
다음 우리말과 같은 뜻이 되도록 [조건]에 맞게 영어로 쓰시오.

"전문 행사 기획자들은 점점 커지는 윤리적·법적 책무를 지닌다"

[조건] (1) an, and, duty, ethical, event, have, increasing, legal, planners, professional 을 모두 사용
       (2) 정확히 10단어로 쓸 것

det.korean: '전문 행사 기획자들(professional event planners)'이 주어이고 복수이므로 동사 have를 쓴다. 목적어는 '점점 커지는 윤리적·법적 책무(an increasing ethical and legal duty)'. 본문 그대로의 표현이다.
det.analysis:
주어부터 잡아요: professional event planners(전문 행사 기획자들, 복수) → 복수동사 have.

목적어 '책무'는 duty인데, '하나의(an)' + '점점 커지는(increasing)' + '윤리적·법적(ethical and legal)'이 순서대로 duty를 꾸며요.

그래서 'professional event planners have an increasing ethical and legal duty'(정확히 10단어)가 완성돼요. 복수 주어라 have를 쓰는 점이 핵심이에요.
det.tip: 복수 주어(planners) + have + an increasing ethical and legal duty
